description: Makes the running editor scan for files written outside it. Call it again when another tool names a class_name under unseenByEditor. editor_launch restart does it too. Needs the editor connected. A scan rewrites the class list in .godot, writes missing .uid files, and reloads scripts naming a class it brings in.

listMembers.description: With reloadScript: also answer the whole member lists. Default false.

reloadScript.description: A script to recompile in the editor after the scan, or a list recompiled in order. A @tool script or one that does not compile is not reloaded. One with unsaved edits in a script tab is reloaded from the file, and saving the tab writes them back over it.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the scan. Default 30000.

name: editor_rescan
title: Rescan the project
